description: Weekly batch policy: one grouped non-major PR on Monday mornings, majors separate. Extend with "github>ardzero/sora-renovate:weekly".

packageRules.description: Batch all non-major npm updates into one weekly PR and automerge it once CI passes
0.x minor updates can break (semver): their own PR, reviewed by hand
Major npm updates always need manual review
Batch GitHub Actions and workflow Node.js updates into one PR; majors get their own PR for review
Node.js in workflows is tracked by the custom regex manager below (keeps the major-only format), not by the github-actions manager
Only move workflow Node.js between even (LTS) majors, keeping the major-only format
engines.node is the minimum Node.js users need, a deliberate support decision; don't raise it on every Node release

customManagers.description: Track the major-only Node.js version in workflows (node-version: "26")
